svg.title: 北京AI原点社区 / Beijing AI Origin Community - B - 安静共享界面 / Quiet shared interface
svg.desc: Civic Continuity Protocol; Decision-ready. Implementation-gated. Beijing AI Origin Community serves as the Open Translation Commons. Option B, Quiet shared interface. Provisional concept grid, not an official boundary. Public value is read first. Conditional study sequence: N · Service-first study (ALT-ORIGIN-N) -> B · Quiet shared interface (ALT-ORIGIN-B) -> A · Dual-channel service (ALT-ORIGIN-A); study lead: ALT-ORIGIN-B. Project loop LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION: REVISE returns to evidence and STOP returns to N while retaining evidence; production loop LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY: validation failure returns to revision and sealing waits for every seal condition. Public value: Reduce sensory, comprehension and low-tech access burdens for daily users. Footprint: Reversible quiet-route band; path U Flow: Two interfaces with an AI-off detour Beneficiary: daily users facing sensory, comprehension, or low-tech access burdens Burdens: unverified obstacles or entrances may be drawn as real · space burden · rent or displacement pressure Exit: Remove digital media; retain physical wayfinding only after field verification. Gate: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES · BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION Unknowns: Exact parcel, entrance, alignment, ownership, control and deployment geometry · Observed accessibility, demand, benefit, burden, dissent and distributional effect · Named authority, staffing, cost, procurement, exit performance and independent validation The OSM context is an exact path extract from a byte-closed R005 SVG; the option overlay is not spatially registered. The graphic scale uses concept units CU, not metres. Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES, BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-ORIGIN-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-ORIGIN, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509. 城市连续服务协议；可决策，待实施门槛。北京AI原点社区承担开放转化场角色。方案 B，安静共享界面。暂定概念网格，非官方边界。公共价值优先核对。 条件性研究序列：N · 维持服务先研究 (ALT-ORIGIN-N) -> B · 安静共享界面 (ALT-ORIGIN-B) -> A · 双通道服务 (ALT-ORIGIN-A)；研究优选：ALT-ORIGIN-B。 项目闭环 LOOP-PROJECT-EVIDENCE-DECISION：REVISE 回取证，STOP 回 N 并保留证据；生成闭环 LOOP-PRODUCTION-GENERATE-VERIFY：验证失败即回改，全部封印条件满足才封印。 公共价值: 降低日常使用者的刺激、理解与低技术通行负担。 空间足迹: 可逆安静路径带；路线 U 流线: 两处接口并设 AI-off 绕行 受益者: 面对刺激、理解或低技术通行负担的日常使用者 负担: 可能把未核实障碍或入口画成事实 · 空间负担 · 租金或置换压力 退出: 移除数位媒体；物理导向只在现勘后保留。 门槛: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL · BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES · BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN · BLK-X5-COST-EXIT · BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION 未知: 精确地块、入口、线位、权属、管控与部署几何 · 实测无障碍、需求、利益、负担、异议与分配效应 · 具名权责、人力、成本、采购、退出表现与独立验证 图中 OSM 背景为 R005 字节闭合 SVG 的精确路径提取；方案 overlay 未做空间配准。图形比例尺使用概念单位 CU，不是米制。 Applicable gate IDs: BLK-X1-OFFICIAL-SPATIAL, BLK-X2-FIELD-INTERFACES, BLK-X3-USER-BURDEN, BLK-X5-COST-EXIT, BLK-X6-INDEPENDENT-VALIDATION. Claims: I-ALT-ORIGIN-B, U-SPATIAL-LOCATION, U-REAL-USE, U-IMPLEMENTATION. Sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-R005-METRICS, SRC-R005-OSM-ORIGIN, SRC-R005-GEOMETRY, SRC-R005-ARCHIVE. Bid claims: I-CIVIC-CONTINUITY-PROTOCOL, I-BRIEF-ALIGNMENT-001, I-CONDITIONAL-PATH-001, I-DECISION-REQUEST-001, I-PROGRAMME-100D-001, I-DELIVERY-CONTROLS-001, I-SELF-LOOP-001, U-BID-ADMIN-INPUT-001. Bid sources: SRC-R006-MODEL, SRC-OFFICIAL-BRIEF-FACTS-20260509.
